articles.title: Ukraine warns of interceptor missile shortage as 23 killed in Kyiv region
articles.description: President Zelensky says Sunday's "massive Russian attack" on Kyiv consisted of 68 missiles and 351 strike drones.

articles.title: Super Typhoon Bavi strikes US Pacific islands with pummeling winds
articles.description: The storm lashed the Mariana Islands, hitting Rota and prompting emergency warnings on Guam.

articles.title: China carries out ballistic missile test hours after warning neighbouring countries
articles.description: China carried out a long-range ballistic missile test in the south Pacific on Monday, sparking criticism from New Zealand and Australia.

articles.title: Major Ukrainian drone attack on Russia strikes St Petersburg oil terminal
articles.description: Ukrainian drones have struck an oil terminal and port in St Petersburg and the surrounding region, Russian and Ukrainian officials say.
